blurb: Guests board the historical M.V. Chippewa III for cruises on Lake Ontario and Georgian Bay. Cruises include afternoon sightseeing, sunset cruises, and catered dinner cruises with buffet meals and local wines. Cruises last about two hours, with private charters allowing custom durations.

quotes.text: So nice to discover the Chippewa after many years of coming to Parry Sound as a cottager; how did I miss it? The Captain is friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. The staffs are so helpful and accommodating on all fronts. So much better to be close to the water with not more than about 30 friendly!

Spectacular sunset on calm water, fresh air and great company-it could not have been better! Wrapping up the cruise our landing back at the dock was so smooth that many did not realize we had landed dockside; the mark of a skilled Captain! A most memorable evening, one we hope to do again.
Our cruise was so memorable. The Chippewa is a decommissioned Maid of the Mist and just bursting with history. She is a pleasure to cruise upon and offers a pure helping of true Canadian pride.
